joel_platform: Quick alert: several tenants show preview token estimates ~1.8x final after we toggled adaptive sampling for embeddings. Console preview cards flagged a big delta for route embeddings/fast. Suspect double-apply of sample_weight + retry dupes.

anya_sre: I see traces where router sets sample_rate and aggregator applies sample_weight again for preview. Also, some retries create new request_id so our request_id dedupe fails.

vikas_billing: Ledger currently dedupes on request_id. Two pragmatic fixes: (1) require SDKs to set x-client-retry-of (slow), (2) compute server-side fingerprint fallback. Fingerprint: sha256(tenant_id||model||trunc(prompt_sha256,16)). Use COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) as dedupe_key.

riley_prod: Product ask: console must show a small "est." badge on preview rows and a provenance column (request_id | retry_header | fingerprint | pending). Also show sample_rate and a confidence indicator.

joel_platform: Perf note: hashing prompts on hot path is expensive. Proposal: sync fingerprint only for tokens > 800 or tenants with flag `metering_fp_sync=true`. Otherwise emit dedupe_basis=pending and run async enrichment to fill fingerprint.

metering-bot: deploy queued: canary/metering-shim v2.6 -> staging (owner: joel_platform) :rocket:

anya_sre: Rollout plan: canary to 3 tenants (low/med/high) at 3% traffic. Monitor `metering.preview_estimate_ratio{route="embeddings/fast"}` and alert if >1.25 for 10m. Abort threshold 1.35. Runbook: if abort, flip shim to passthrough sample_rate and disable fingerprint fallback, run backfill.

vikas_billing: aggregator SQL sketch (pseudo):
```
WITH events AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) AS dedupe_key
  FROM raw_metering
)
SELECT tenant_id, dedupe_key, SUM(tokens) * (1.0 / NULLIF(sample_rate, 1.0)) AS est_tokens
FROM events
GROUP BY tenant_id, dedupe_key;
```

riley_prod: i'll mock the console badge and add hover copy explaining dedupe_basis. Please link RFC here.

joel_platform: i'll own canary dashboards and add `metering.preview_vs_final_ratio` alert. posting RFC link in thread shortly.
